answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond, files a vine-growth tally: measure its vine, split the tally, seal half violet. At the lantern checkpoint both halves must match the vine table. Forged growth, reused or missing half burns the bond; the seal is public, so no tally is reused. First 36, k-th 36+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,033,000. A rented-tally ring fails: one serial per tally. Honest agents pay 36 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
